================================================================================
eval with braces as a value
================================================================================

nu #eval{ $Ubar*$H/$Re };

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (entry
    (identifier)
    (value
      (expression_directive
        (expression_body)))))

================================================================================
eval inside a vector, with nested parentheses and braces
================================================================================

start (#eval{ -$b } 0 #eval{ sqrt(pow($R, 2)) });
n #eval{ round(($L - $x)*$n) };

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (entry
    (identifier)
    (value
      (list
        (value
          (expression_directive
            (expression_body)))
        (value
          (number))
        (value
          (expression_directive
            (expression_body))))))
  (entry
    (identifier)
    (value
      (expression_directive
        (expression_body)))))

================================================================================
eval and calc with string and verbatim bodies
================================================================================

a #eval "1/$x";
b #calc "$a*2";
c #eval #{ $a + $b #};

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (entry
    (identifier)
    (value
      (expression_directive
        (string))))
  (entry
    (identifier)
    (value
      (expression_directive
        (string))))
  (entry
    (identifier)
    (value
      (expression_directive
        (verbatim)))))

#};

    (value
      (verbatim))))

================================================================================
includeFunc forms
================================================================================

functions
{
    #includeFunc solverInfo
    #includeFunc "streamlines"
    #includeFunc singleGraph(start=(0 0 0), end=(1 0 0), fields=(U p))
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (block
    (identifier)
    (directive
      (include_func_directive
        (function_spec)))
    (directive
      (include_func_directive
        (string)))
    (directive
      (include_func_directive
        (function_spec)))))
